'''Shok Tinoktin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rhommamoolian|native]] of [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], he became allied with [[Nom Anor]], a fanatical despiser of machines and his followers, the [[Red Knights of Life]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What happened to your slave, that mousy little man?"<br />"Shok Tinoktin was well rewarded for faithful service.|Jaina Solo and Nom Anor converse on Duro|<ref name="BP1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Osarian-Rhommamool conflict]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], shortly before the onset of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Shok Tinoktin was drafted into the anti-technology terrorist group known as the [[Red Knights of Life]]. He later served on the [[Rhommamoolian Senate]] as one of group leader [[Nom Anor]]'s advisors on [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]] and became one of his closest associates, though Tinoktin remained ignorant of Anor's true nature as a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agent.<ref name="VP1" />

Tinoktin was later present at a meeting in the Rhommamoolian capital [[Redhaven]] attended by former [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], their [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bolpuhr]]. Following a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] [[Battle of Osarian|attack]] on neighboring [[Osarian]], Anor and Tinoktin fled Rhommamool in a disguised [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by Tinoktin; Anor faked his [[Death/Legends|death]] aboard the intervening [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Mediator (Mediator-class)|''Mediator'']] using a primitive rocket-based [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] packed with nuclear explosives, which was remotely guided by Tinoktin. Tinoktin later fell asleep in the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter's]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], barely missing Anor's conversation with Yuuzhan Vong [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]] regarding the [[Destruction of Sernpidal|destruction]] of [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. Catching the final words of the discussion but not comprehending what had been said, Tinoktin assumed that Anor was merely preparing another speech.<ref name="VP1" />

In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during a confrontation with Skywalker and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], Anor revealed that Shok Tinoktin had been well rewarded for his faithful service to both Anor and the Red Knights of Life.<ref name="BP1" />

==Personality and traits==
Shok Tinoktin was largely unintelligent and ignorant, and was utterly unaware of Nom Anor's true allegiances to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], simply believing him to be a pro-organic radical. He was also afraid of Anor, dreading any scenario in which the Red Knight's leader would look on him with disfavor.<ref name="VP1" /> He was lanky and reedy, and likened by Jaina Solo to a [[Mouse/Legends|mouse]].<ref name="BP1" />

==Skills and abilities==
Shok Tinoktin was a reasonably skilled pilot, working overtime to guide Nom Anor's decoy rocket toward the ''Mediator'' so as to deliver its explosive payload. He was also somewhat proficient in handling an A-wing [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]], being trusted by Anor to fly such a craft.<ref name="VP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shok Tinoktin was first introduced in [[R. A. Salvatore]]'s [[1999]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', the first in [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|the New Jedi Order]] series.<ref name="VP1" /> He also received a brief mention in a later novel, ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'' by [[Kathy Tyers]], which was published in [[2000]].<ref name="BP1" />
